name: pdf-editor
description: SsPdfEditor: a browser-based, fully local PDF editor

scripts.build: pnpm --filter site build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.unit: vitest run --passWithNoTests --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=node_modules/.vitest-report.json && node tools/audit/require-tests.mjs && node tools/audit/regressions.cjs
scripts.ci:behavior: node tools/spikes/phase3-check.mjs && node tools/spikes/phase4-check.mjs && tsx tools/spikes/sign-check.mts
scripts.ci:verify: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check && pnpm unit && pnpm audit:model-types && pnpm build && pnpm fetch:engines --sync && pnpm verify:assets && pnpm check:licenses && pnpm assemble:dist
scripts.worker:deploy: pnpm run assemble:dist && npx --yes wrangler@4.135.0 deploy
scripts.worker:deploy:dry: pnpm run assemble:dist && npx --yes wrangler@4.135.0 deploy --dry-run

author: isolmaz <info@isolmaz.com>
